name: mujoco_local_scan_physical_pedestrian
description: Thunder V4 truth-localized SCAN navigation through a physical crossing pedestrian in the existing IndustrialPark world.

claims: existing mocap pedestrian collision geometry moves across the robot route
actual ray-cast LiDAR observes a physical moving-actor encounter
native SCAN stops for the observed moving obstacle and resumes toward the goal
every visible physical step is checked for entity contact, with final arrival and exact driver stop
excluded_claims: Go2 hardware motion or field safety clearance
predictive pedestrian tracking or a dynamic-obstacle benchmark campaign
